description: Managed device driver for the BirdDog BD4KHDMI.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: BirdDog header with a Connected light, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect button: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only while the device answers, a device that stops answering is dropped and retried, and the link is dropped during a reboot.
